issues.description: play.ts ships a debugging scratchpad with hardcoded relative imports
issues.detail: play.ts was rewritten from a canonical zod/v4 import into a console.log debugging session using a relative path into packages/zod/src/index.js. This is a maintainer's local scribble that couples a top-level file to internal source layout. Drop or revert play.ts before merge.

issues.description: JSON.stringify-based dedup in finalize is wrong data structure and quadratic
issues.detail: Two passes in finalize() compare schema values via JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b) on every key. This is order-dependent, silently wrong for undefined/Dates/functions, and O(N*size) on nested schemas. Extract a named structural-equality helper or fingerprint the def once instead of stringify-as-equals scattered across the loop.

issues.description: Removal of isParent guard silently doubles ctx.override invocations
issues.detail: The old code guarded `if (!seen.isParent) ctx.override(...)`; the new code calls override unconditionally. The test literally named 'do not run on references' was updated from 6 to 12 calls to pass. Either the test name is now a lie or behavior regressed. Justify the new contract in the changelog or restore the guard.

issues.description: Seen.ref and Seen.parent carry overlapping meaning without a written contract
issues.detail: Seen gained a parent field alongside ref, and finalize() juggles ref===parent, ref!==parent, and ref===null sentinel cases. The precedence rules live in comments rather than types. Document the invariant on the Seen interface or collapse to one field with an explicit kind so future maintainers do not re-confuse them.

issues.description: flattenRef recursion via seen.parent has no clear termination guarantee
issues.detail: flattenRef uses seen.ref=null as a recursion guard, then re-enters via flattenRef(seen.parent) — a different field with no equivalent guard. Termination depends on the parent's own ref already being nulled by call ordering. Add an explicit visited set or state the invariant; the type system does not prevent parent cycles.

issues.description: Commit bundles three independent changes that should be separate patches
issues.detail: The diff combines (a) parent/ref tracking rework, (b) fileProcessor anyOf hoisting (a user-visible JSON Schema output change), and (c) the mini ZodType {parent: true} flip. Each is independently reviewable and revertable. Split into three patches so the override-semantics change and the schema-shape change can be evaluated on their own merits.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. The core insight — separating clone-chain `parent` from processor-set `ref` so $ref propagates through wrappers like readonly().meta({id}).describe() — is sound and fixes a real bug. But the patch ships in the wrong shape: a debugging scratchpad in play.ts, JSON.stringify-based dedup that is both algorithmically wrong and quadratic, and a silent doubling of ctx.override invocations against a test literally named "do not run on references". The new Seen two-field contract and flattenRef recursion via seen.parent also lack stated invariants. Split into three patches, drop play.ts, justify or revert the override-count change, and replace stringify-equals with a named structural-equality helper before landing.
